turns.text: I think technology has changed the way young people communicate, mostly through social media and messaging apps.
On the positive side, it's much easier to stay in touch with relatives abroad, for example my brother in Canada.
However, I feel that people are spending less time talking face to face, and that can affect their social skills.
Personally I try to limit my screen time, although honestly it's difficult because my studies are also online.
Overall I would say technology is a tool, and whether it's good or bad depends on how responsibly we use it.
